### Fixed

- (gs) [Drop the Alerts link from the cluster details page's default links on the 0.244 line](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2819) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — The cluster details page's tools card no longer shows an `Alerts` link by default, which led customers to a Grafana page they can't open. A portal that sets `gs.clusterDetails.resources` keeps exactly the links it lists.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v0.246.3...v0.246.4
